$comment: Updates this repo has decided not to take yet. Read by scripts/check-dependency-updates.ts,
which fails on any compatible update — patch, minor, or prerelease-to-stable — that a pin has
not taken. An entry here downgrades that failure to a warning until its date; it never hides it.
`until` is exclusive: a deferral dated 2026-09-01 stops applying on 2026-09-01. Give a reason a
reader in three months can act on — what breaks, and what has to happen first.
`manifest` scopes an entry to one manifest; omit it and the entry speaks for every pin of that
name, which is wrong whenever the same package is pinned twice for different reasons.
`acceptedVulnerabilities` is the other half: a vulnerability this repo ships with, because the
install delay in bunfig.toml is never punctured — not even to reach a fix. A release published
days ago is how a compromised package arrives, so the delay outranks a known CVE, and when the
only fix is too young the vulnerability is carried instead. Each entry pairs one advisory with
one lockfile, matching an `sca.exclusions` entry in .fluidattacks/sca.yaml, which is where the
scanner is told to stop counting it. The reason and the expiry live here because that config
has nowhere to put them. An exclusion with no entry fails, an expired entry fails, and so does
an entry whose exclusion is gone.

deferredUpdates.name: @hugeicons/core-free-icons
deferredUpdates.reason: 4.3.4 publishes dist/esm/index.js exports for Grid2x2 and Grid3x2 icons with lowercase x, but its Linux tarball contains only uppercase X filenames. Vite production builds and browser acceptance fail on case-sensitive runners. Keep 4.3.3 until the publisher fixes the export paths; verify the package tarball and Linux build before updating.

deferredUpdates.name: jsdom
deferredUpdates.reason: jsdom 30.1.0 breaks the Vitest 5.0.1 jsdom worker environment: its Window addEventListener rejects Vitest's Window proxy as an invalid EventTarget, so all browser unit tests fail before execution. Keep 30.0.1 until the Vitest/jsdom integration supports this release; rerun web and browser tests before updating.

deferredUpdates.name: typescript
deferredUpdates.reason: With TypeScript 7.0.2, dependency-cruiser silently cruises zero modules and the repo's tripwire exits because no architecture rules ran. Revisit after TypeScript 7.1 ships the replacement compiler API and dependency-cruiser adopts it.

deferredUpdates.name: typescript
deferredUpdates.reason: With TypeScript 7.0.2, Stryker's tsconfig rewrite crashes because parseConfigFileTextToJson is missing. Revisit after TypeScript 7.1 ships the replacement compiler API and Stryker adopts it.

deferredUpdates.name: @effect/tsgo
deferredUpdates.reason: 0.47.0 introduces 1,148 unstableApiUsage warnings for required Effect v4 HTTP, MCP, runtime and test APIs; the warning-failing project-reference build exits nonzero although no type errors occur. Its patch CLI also requires an otherwise unused --force flag. Retain verified 0.46.1 without suppressing compiler diagnostics. Revisit the upstream default severity and supported stable replacements before updating, then rerun the normal installer, typecheck and unit verification.

deferredUpdates.name: wrangler
deferredUpdates.reason: Updating Wrangler to 4.145.0 with the pinned Bun forces workspace re-resolution and refuses the existing Effect 4.0.0 (published 2026-10-01) and Alchemy 2.0.0-beta.80 (published 2026-10-02) resolutions under the unchanged seven-day minimumReleaseAge. Both bun install and targeted bun update reproduce the failure. Retain the frozen lockfile and Wrangler 4.144.0 until these resolutions become eligible, then upgrade all three Wrangler pins with the normal installer and rerun workspace, Cloudflare infrastructure, adapter, build and browser checks. Do not add install-age exclusions.

deferredUpdates.name: rolldown
deferredUpdates.reason: Rolldown 1.2.12 became eligible while validating #236. The pinned Bun re-resolves the workspace on a dependency update and rejects existing Effect 4.0.0 (published 2026-10-01) and Alchemy 2.0.0-beta.80 (published 2026-10-02) under the unchanged seven-day minimumReleaseAge, reproduced by normal and targeted updates. Retain the frozen lockfile and Rolldown 1.2.11 until those resolutions are eligible, then use the normal installer and rerun server bundling and Cloudflare adapter tests. Do not add install-age exclusions.

acceptedVulnerabilities.reason: Temporarily retain the required shadcn 4.21.0 development CLI, whose fast-glob and ts-morph dependencies bring in braces 3.0.3. GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm reports stack exhaustion from deeply nested brace patterns; no patched npm release exists as of 2026-10-03. This is risk acceptance, not remediation: the vulnerable package remains installed. Limit CLI use to reviewed component names, local paths and trusted registry inputs during this window. Recheck upstream before expiry; replace or upgrade the affected chain only after every new release meets the unchanged seven-day minimumReleaseAge, rerun CLI and application verification plus SCA, and remove both this record and the matching scanner exclusion once the finding is resolved.

Temporarily retain source-map-js 1.2.1 in the Vite/Tailwind, jsdom and related build/test tooling graph. GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q reports event-loop denial of service from malicious indexed source-map section offsets. The 1.2.2 fix was published 2026-09-30T14:08:09.382Z and becomes eligible under the unchanged seven-day minimumReleaseAge on 2026-10-07T14:08:09.382Z. This is risk acceptance, not remediation: the vulnerable package remains installed. During this window, build and test only reviewed repository sources and trusted source maps; do not process externally supplied source maps or expose the development server to untrusted clients. Upgrade the transitive resolution to 1.2.2 after eligibility, rerun builds/browser tests/SCA, and remove this record and its matching scanner exclusion before expiry.
